2023-4289-4518-6633.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

465-618-4247.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Goblin, Orc or Army you control

4017-7855.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give The Great Goblin lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
4017-7855.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 2 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

4091-4171-7791.description:
Activate Kozilek's Channeler by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Kozilek's Channeler.
Repeat.

3054-5346-6798-6809.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-7730.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

206-222-527-2292.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-3990-5776.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce mana.
1978-3990-5776.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

977-1414-2051-4668-5751.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in your hand.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
977-1414-2051-4668-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5104-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature token.
Your life total is at least 2.
5104-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

856-4231-7047.description:
Activate June by paying {1} and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1402-2218-4763-4927.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1965-2173-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1170-3389-4826-5954-6751.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2022-3221.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a copy of Wedding Ring.
You have a way to draw a card.
2022-3221.description:
Draw a card by any method.
The opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Notion Thief causes that opponent to skip that draw, and causes you to draw a card instead.
Repeat from step 2 until you remove a combo piece from the board at instant speed; if you do not you will draw from an empty library and lose the game.
2022-3221.notes: The most straightforward use of this combo is in decks that have a way to win the game at instant speed after drawing their deck, for example by putting any Laboratory Maniac effect onto the battlefield at instant speed. This usually requires additional starting mana.

971-3008-3048-3197.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
971-3008-3048-3197.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth and two charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Pentad Prism twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

877-3249-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard that can be cast by paying {0} due to Morophon.
877-3249-4050.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature cast in step 2, adding {1}.
Repeat.

751-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token or a Gold token.
751-5554.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a copy of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate any Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, or any Gold by sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

57-2034-2178-4891.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2034-2178-4891.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Atsushi with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Feldon.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Feldon trigger, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead exile cards using Atsushi and cast them from exile this turn.

264-1218.notablePrerequisites:
Lord of Tresserhorn does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Lord of Tresserhorn.
264-1218.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Lord of Tresserhorn +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Lord of Tresserhorn, causing target opponent to get eleven poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
